statement: ∀ j : ℕ, 62≤j → j≤597 → let n : ℕ := 2^j; ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p+q=n

plain_statement.en: New route · V06 · Certify the prime pairs at dyadic endpoints with exponents 62 through 597
